The '''XAD Omnisight''' was a model of [[Multi-optic sight/Legends|multi-optic sight]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and sold for 2000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
